## Tips & gotchas

- A locker reduces the risk of snapping half shafts by preventing one wheel from spinning fast while the other has less traction. [t2061]
- It allows for creeping over obstacles with finesse rather than relying on brute force and momentum to clear them. [t2061]
- Lunch box lockers are known to pop and snap like a Detroit Locker in the rear. [t2061]
- They can waste idler arms and center links on regular independent front suspension rigs during the first wheeling trip. [t2061]
- Replacement pins with tiny springs behind them should be kept on hand as they are small parts prone to failure. [t2061]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Running a lunch box locker without being prepared for steering side-to-side movement over ice patches or flat ground. [t2061]
